title: Not recommended. Inconsistent
text:
Not recommended. Inconsistent. The first time we used the toaster was for a frozen eggo waffle. We set it on 4 and kept an eye on it. It was perfect The next morning, our waffle loving little guy wanted another waffle, we popped it in and it never popped up. Realizing it didn't pop up, we manually popped it up and the waffle was black. He still wanted a waffle, so we set on 1. The waffle came out like it did on 4 the first day. Now, we just aren't sure what to think of this toaster but we know not to leave it unattended for fear of it catching fire.

I do not recommend.
